create_server_tls_policy: create a GCP server TLS policy with a given name and configuration body
get_server_tls_policy: get an existing GCP server TLS policy by name and return its details
delete_server_tls_policy: delete an existing GCP server TLS policy by its name
create_client_tls_policy: create a GCP client TLS policy with a given name and configuration body
get_client_tls_policy: get an existing GCP client TLS policy by name and return its details
